skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Phase Face
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Phase Face. Clothes that show off both Tin Man's classical and surrealist sides. The final design was put together using Furnace illusions. A sense of strangeness blurs the line between illusion and reality.
skins.usage: One of Tin Man's casual outfits.
skins.quote: A revenant's self-identity is ever-changing. The way they see themselves is often different from what we perceive.
